name: Hougang
summary: Northeast NEL town with Kovan/Hougang mall gravity, mixed old-and-new HDB, and shorter CBD hops than Sengkang or Punggol — denser and louder than its quieter Reddit reputation.
body: Hougang is the northeast shortlist when Punggol feels too new-and-far and Serangoon’s NEX crush feels like a second job. Hougang and Kovan MRT on the North-East Line, Hougang Mall / Heartland Mall clusters, and the Upper Serangoon Road food belt cover errands without forcing a car. Housing mixes mature HDB, newer BTO pockets, and condo stacks toward Kovan — whole-flat rents usually undercut Serangoon Central for similar bedroom counts because you trade interchange prestige for slightly longer rides. Peak NEL crowding is real; Cross Island Line hopes are long-dated. Watch-outs: feeder-bus frustration on some estates, aircraft noise pockets nearer Paya Lebar Air Base approaches, and sequential HDB renovation seasons in older blocks. Compare with Serangoon for dual-line mall gravity, Sengkang for newer flats further out, or Toa Payoh if you want NSL maturity instead of NEL.
